subject: english
question:
Select the appropriate option that can substitute the underlined phrase in the following sentence.

Even though she’s a celebrity, she __doesn’t draw any attention towards herself__.
solution: The correct answer is **Option 2)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"keeps a low profile"** means to avoid attracting attention or publicity. (ध्यान आकर्षित करने से बचना) • **Example: **Despite his fame, the actor **keeps a low profile **and rarely appears in public. • **"Even though she’s a celebrity, she doesn’t draw any attention towards herself."** implies that she avoids the limelight and public attention. (वह खुद पर ध्यान आकर्षित करने से बचती है) • **Example: **Even though she’s a celebrity, she** keeps a low profile **and doesn’t draw any attention towards herself. Therefore, the correct answer is: **'keeps a low profile'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Keeps hot under the collar **(गुस्से में रहना): To be angry or agitated. • **Example:** He **keeps hot under the collar **whenever someone criticizes his work. • **Keeps up with the Joneses **(दूसरों की बराबरी करना): To try to match the lifestyle of one's neighbors or peers. • **Example: **She buys new gadgets just to **keep up with the Joneses.** • **Is hard to come by **(दुर्लभ होना): To be rare or difficult to obtain. • **Example:** In this remote area, fresh vegetables **are hard to come by.** 41:Tcd7, The correct answer is **Option 2)**
